categories.main_business_segments: Open Door Inc. operates primarily in the travel-related business, with its core activity being the operation of the travel comparison site 'Travelko.' The group also includes a consolidated subsidiary, Hotel Skip Co., Ltd., which manages hotel and airline ticket reservation sites. The company focuses almost exclusively on travel-related services, with other business segments being immaterial.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's main technological foundation is its proprietary meta-search platform, which aggregates and compares travel products from over 1,500 domestic and international booking sites. The system includes automated data integration, cross-category search functions, and a robust backend for tracking user actions (clicks, reservations, etc.) to calculate performance-based fees. The company also invests in AI-driven search features and multilingual support for inbound and outbound travel demand.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are travel agencies, OTAs (Online Travel Agents), airlines, and hotels that list their products on Travelko, as well as end-users (consumers) seeking to compare and book travel products online. The main end markets are Japanese domestic and outbound travelers, as well as inbound tourists and international users through multilingual services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in Japan, with the vast majority of revenue coming from domestic customers. However, it also targets overseas markets through multilingual versions of its comparison site and aims to capture inbound travel demand and overseas-to-overseas travel bookings.
categories.supply_chain_position: Open Door functions as an intermediary platform (midstream) in the travel industry supply chain, connecting travel product suppliers (agencies, airlines, hotels) with end consumers via its meta-search and reservation platforms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the competitiveness of existing services, expanding into new business areas, enhancing brand recognition, and accelerating overseas and inbound business. The company is investing in new service development (e.g., cruise comparison, AI search), AI-based corporate solutions, and expanding online reservation systems for travel agencies. There is a focus on technology adaptation, especially AI, and on broadening the target market.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of performance-based fees (pay-per-reservation, click, or email), fixed monthly system usage fees from travel agencies, and advertising fees from travel-related companies. The majority of revenue is performance-based, tied to user actions on the platform.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other travel meta-search and comparison sites, as well as large OTAs with direct booking capabilities. The company positions itself as a leading travel meta-search platform in Japan, emphasizing the breadth of its content and user-friendly features, but faces intense competition from both domestic and international players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales were approximately 2.4 billion yen, with a net loss of about 120 million yen. The company has experienced fluctuating revenues and persistent losses in recent years, with a slight decrease in sales year-on-year and ongoing challenges in achieving profitability. Total assets are around 4.8 billion yen, and the company employs about 192 people.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Open Door's value proposition centers on providing comprehensive, unbiased, and free travel product comparisons across a wide range of categories and suppliers, enabling users to find the best deals efficiently. The platform differentiates itself through the breadth of its content, cross-category search capabilities, and the inclusion of professional and user-generated local reviews, aiming to be a one-stop solution for travel planning.
